realizes.rationale: Preparation now carries the inspected returned_range; resolution requires every claimed interval to fit it. The independent nonexistent 999-999 basis now resolves false, matching the real absent bound read; line-1 positive and typed authored-judgment/proof/mechanical/inference, absent-item and comparison/applicability controls pass. Existing exact typed owner/attempt/revision and non-invented execution checks are retained.
